_note: The Crowd Navigation Lab (115, ADR-2229). Environments are generated by build.py (edit the script, not the JSON) and use only a flat procedural terrain, authored walls and the CC0 alien. Case numbers are 100 x environment + k. Every expectation is asserted in tests/unit/test_crowd_world.cpp; open a case with avgen --lab-case crowd:N and the crowd debug layer.

cases.title: Flat plaza: two groups cross three times
cases.question: Do two groups of 25 crossing each other's path between four areas arrive without touching?
cases.expectation: Every agent arrives at each of the three destinations; no two agents overlap by more than 0.03 m at any step (tests/unit/test_crowd_world.cpp, 'crowd lab 101'). The crowd layer shows every disc green (arrived) before 35 s, 70 s and 105 s.

cases.title: Flat plaza: a walking CC0 character's feet do not skate
cases.question: Does the gait the crowd drives match the clip to the body's speed?
cases.expectation: The planted toe's median world speed over the body's speed is at most 0.15 (test 'crowd lab 104').

cases.title: Obstacles and two openings
cases.question: Does every agent find a route through a wall with two openings and round a field of blocks, without entering a wall?
cases.expectation: All 40 arrive; path status ok for every agent; wall penetration at most 0.01 m; overlap at most 0.03 m (test 'crowd lab 201').

cases.title: Bottleneck, 50 agents
cases.question: Does a 2 m gap jam at 50 agents?
cases.expectation: All arrive within 120 s; overlap at most 0.03 m (test 'crowd lab 301-303').

cases.title: Bottleneck, 100 agents
cases.question: Does a 2 m gap jam at 100 agents?

cases.title: Bottleneck, 200 agents
cases.question: Does a 2 m gap jam at 200 agents, and what does a step cost?
cases.expectation: As 301; the test prints the step cost (median and p95 thread CPU) for the report.

cases.title: Checkpointed seek equals the full replay
cases.question: Does a seek land the crowd exactly where a play from zero does?
cases.expectation: At ten seeded random seconds the crowd's state hash after a checkpointed seek equals a from-zero replay's (test 'crowd lab 801').

cases.title: The same bits on any thread count
cases.question: Is the Jacobi avoidance step independent of how agents are split between threads?
cases.expectation: 1, 4 and 8 threads give one state hash at 40 s (test 'crowd lab 802').

cases.title: A play through the composition equals a cold seek
cases.question: Does a 30 fps play (two crowd steps a frame) equal a seek straight to the same second, and is the node drawn where the crowd says?
cases.expectation: Equal state hashes at 20 s; the node's position final equals the crowd's pose (test 'crowd lab 803').
